task.title: Compact filter bar and one-row header on narrow hosts
task.description:
The orchestrator opened the integrated explorer in a browser on this repository. The graph, the panel, Back, the kept state and the theme switch all work. One defect blocks AC20: the filter bar is too tall. Measured: 131 px at a 796 px wide content column, 158 px at 440 px (panel open, default 1180x780 window), 190 px once 'Reset filters' shows, 182 px at the minimum window. At 720x480 with the panel closed and no banner only 114 px of the graph box are visible (the criterion asks for at least 140): the header takes 91 px in two rows and the filter bar 182 px.

1. (Revised on the operator's direction: a button that opens a popover, not a row in the flow.) The filter bar goes away as a block. One 'Filters' button sits in the graph's header row, left of the zoom controls: `RelationshipGraph` gets an optional `actions` slot rendered there and the explorer passes the button. The button opens a popover anchored under it that holds Direction, Depth, the relationship-type toggles with their readable labels, the symbol-layer reason (only while Defines and Calls are disabled) and 'Reset filters' (only while the filters differ from their defaults). A change applies at once, with the graph visible behind the popover. The popover is a non-modal dialog (`role="dialog"`, labelled 'Graph filters'): focus moves into it on open; Escape or a click outside closes it and returns focus to the button; the button carries `aria-haspopup="dialog"` and `aria-expanded`. While the filters differ from their defaults the button says how many settings differ (for example 'Filters · 2') and takes the pressed chip treatment, and its title states the current settings ('Both · 2 steps · 7 of 9 types'), so a changed filter is never invisible. Where no graph is drawn (the graph is missing) the button sits in a slim row of its own, so the filters stay reachable. Reuse the app's existing menu and popover pattern (apps/desktop/src/components/Menu.tsx and its styles, `--shadow-pop`) instead of inventing one.
2. Header in one row on a narrow host. Inside the explorer's existing narrow container query the 'Metaproject' heading is visually hidden but stays in the accessibility tree, so Back, the search field and the view switch share one row.
3. Result to reach: at the minimum window (720x480, a 660 px wide host) with the panel closed and no warning banner, at least 140 px of graph height is visible without scrolling. The orchestrator measures it again in the browser.

Tests: the filter tests of AC17 open the popover first; new tests cover closed by default, opening and closing (button, Escape, click outside, focus back on the button), the count and pressed look when filters differ from the defaults, Reset, and the `actions` slot of `RelationshipGraph`.

acceptance_criteria: AC17: In Graph mode the relationship list is rendered in the details panel and not under the canvas; filter controls carry human-readable labels; `defines` and `calls` are disabled with a stated reason when the catalog reports no symbol layer; the list header shows "shown of total" from `catalog.counts` instead of the "Catalog is limited" banner; the selected list row is scrolled into view when the selection changes; while relationships for a new selection load, the previous graph stays rendered and is marked busy. [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src/metaproject/MetaprojectView.dom.test.tsx`]

AC20: In the browser dev build, in a dark and a light theme, at 1180×780 and 1440×900: the graph shows incoming neighbours left and outgoing neighbours right of the selected node with group captions and a legend; the details panel shows a header, facts, a tab bar with counts and one primary action per tab; no text overlaps or is clipped. At 720×480 with the panel closed and no warning banner, at least 140 px of graph height is visible without scrolling, and the open panel leaves part of the content visible. [verify: judged]
AC19: The desktop app type-checks and its whole test suite passes. [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bunx tsc --noEmit && bun test src`]
